about: What the owner's real Google Chrome wrote on 29 Sep 2026 (made-up sentences read aloud, fake data), with what the app should do after the owner's decisions of that day. A regression set: every case must be correct.

format.now: 2026-09-29T05:30:00Z (11:00 in India); dates are read in Asia/Kolkata time
format.case: { id, careType, text (exactly what Chrome wrote), said (what was read aloud), expected, why }
format.expected: values, confirm, questions and notes as in voiceCorpusB.json (strict: anything else filled is wrong). Also noQuestions: regexes no question may match; corrections: [{ heard, to }] that must be listed; unused: the parts listed as not understood, exactly.
